findings.title: Missing Access Control on Emergency Drain
findings.description: Anyone can call emergencyDrain and sweep contract balance to an arbitrary address without onlyOwner restriction.
evidence: No msg.sender check or onlyOwner modifier present

findings.title: Unchecked Reentrancy in withdraw() Function
findings.description: The function performs an external transfer of native AVAX before updating the user balance mapping, enabling cross-function reentrancy.
evidence: External call payable(msg.sender).call{value: amount} before balance update
